scope: Hyperbased arrangement through the user-selected musical ending; listening approval remains separate.

startup_loader.scope: Startup only. Original entry and high code restored before playback; score, instruments and playback addresses unchanged.

runtime_reserved_ranges.purpose: bootstrap/main and four native mixing kernels
clock slide, patchers, delays and interrupt templates

score.transients: Offsets15/22 zero each tick; only bits0/1 of23 zero each tick; gain bits persist.

approximations: Two native50Hz SID instrument programs compute waveform, pulse width and envelope stages from note descriptors; source chords use native three-note arpeggios.

Native percussion uses short octave pitch stages; lead23 has four pulse-width stages, lead14 switches waveform, and special effects use noise attacks plus two envelope reductions. Source pitch/portamento sets the base frequency.
Later SID gain rises or inactive-to-active transitions retrigger the envelope and intentionally reset that native instrument age; accepted SID1 first1000ticks remain exempt.
Source1 keeps accepted triangle quantization and source2 keeps accepted pulse register fields in the first20s when routed.
Source8 bass uses a measured-root triangle, not its actual attack/filter recording.
Actual orchestral hit attacks use reused fixed-pitch samples; no rejected single-partial flute.
Every PCM waveform is stored atgain64; native-shift source-gain behavior is declared below. Original percussion/orchestral tails are retained.
Triangle gains outside early accepted values map to the nearest declared table.
More than two simultaneous tonal parts can omit the third-priority tonal source; all omissions are enumerated.
Rare percussion below original sampling rate (period>=400) uses a SID percussion program.

Native PCM shifts replay per-tick source gain quantized to64/32/16; source gains below8 mute while the cursor advances. Every pitch has one full-length waveform. Shift recentering constants are0/57/85 for113-centred codes.
Later snare3 periods214/226, snare9 period269 and clap10 periods143/160 use SID percussion to preserve memory for actual orchestral attacks.
arrangement.digital_scope: Host arrangement and independent instrument assets only; native playback and listening fidelity require separate VICE proof.

coverage.scope: Every omitted active source tick, grouped into exact contiguous passages. Channel seconds can overlap; they are not silent seconds in the complete mix.

deadlines.scope: Every full-song fill completes before its matching hardware pointer activation. Wall time includes NMI work; this is not a foreground CPU percentage.

cpu.scope: Complete native performance. Every NMI and buffer activation measured. Foreground fill includes SID programs, native phase/cursors and PCM mixing; prefetched note decoding is counted separately. Main-control residual includes busy waits. No separate C3 sampler exists.

attribution.scope: Exact non-overlapping wall-cycle partition of the unchanged program, excluding startup and terminal shutdown. NMI cycles are removed from every foreground interval. Main-control/busy-wait residual is not a claim that all those cycles can meet an arbitrary new deadline.

all.processing: Actual independent VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No EQ, host mixing, alignment or dynamics.

sid-1.processing: Actual independent VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No EQ, host mixing, alignment or dynamics.

sid-2.processing: Actual independent VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No EQ, host mixing, alignment or dynamics.

sid-3.processing: Actual independent VICE capture, native-clock crop, DC removal and one shared constant gain. No EQ, host mixing, alignment or dynamics.

mute_control.scope: Independent full-length static-SID control versus muted producer run, common native clock and gain.

sid1_reference.scope: Actual first20s SID1 amplitude/spectral-envelope comparison. Fixed reference gain only; no candidate gain fitting, alignment, audio processing or WAV writing.

loader.scope: Startup only. Original entry and high code restored before playback; score, instruments and playback addresses unchanged.

true_drive_restored_ram.scope: Native RAM at loader_done, before original player entry. I/O is excluded; the declared loader arena is the only excluded RAM.

reference_comparison.scope: Actual first20s SID1 amplitude/spectral-envelope comparison. Fixed reference gain only; no candidate gain fitting, alignment, audio processing or WAV writing.

actual_packed_sid1_audio.measurement: Native unscaled WAV samples, native-clock crop and DC removal only. Raw WAV unchanged; no gain fit, alignment, EQ or host mixing.

startup_fix.evidence_scope: Only startup packaging changed. Existing CPU/deadline receipts and four complete listening WAVs describe the unchanged native image. They were not regenerated. The packed image has a fresh full true-drive register proof and a separate first20s real-audio SID1 reference check.

old_flat_load_fault.scope: Direct VICE trace of the old PRG being loaded by KERNAL ROM. The LOAD itself clears the VIC display-enable register and changes CIA1 before native entry. No CPU jam or eventual timeout is inferred.
